title: End Date of the Signature-Lateness Count on Factory Production Orders
content:
**Ruling.** For Factory Production Orders, the business days of signature lateness — counted from the day after the acknowledgment return window closes — stop at an end date set by how the signature came in:

1. when the acknowledgment was signed while the order was on a customer hold (its hold start date falls on or before the signature date and no hold release was recorded from the hold start date up to the day before the signature), they are counted up to and including the hold start date;
2. when it was not signed during a hold and the most recent factory-capacity or glass-supplier delay notice on the order is dated after the return window closed and on or before the signature date, they are counted up to and including the date of that notice;
3. otherwise they are counted up to and including the signature date.

The days counted are business days, Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays.

## Reading the records

- **Hold start date** — the hold start date shown on the factory order record.
- **Hold release** — a hold release is recorded on the order as a delay notice with cause customer hold, dated the release date.
- **Factory-capacity or glass-supplier delay notice** — the delay notices on the order's milestone records with cause factory capacity or glass supplier; only the most recent of them, across both causes, is compared with the window and the signature date.

## Conditions in combination

| Hold start on or before the signature | Release recorded from the hold start up to the day before the signature | Most recent capacity or glass notice after the window closed and on or before the signature | Count ends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | no | any | the hold start date |
| yes | yes | yes | that notice's date |
| yes | yes | no | the signature date |
| no hold start on record, or hold start after the signature | — | yes | that notice's date |
| no hold start on record, or hold start after the signature | — | no | the signature date |

## Hypothetical cases (no federal holiday in the period)

- The window closes on a Thursday. A hold started on the following Tuesday and was still running when the acknowledgment was signed the Thursday after. The count runs Friday, Monday, Tuesday and ends on the hold start date: 3 business days.
- The window closes on a Thursday; no hold. A factory-capacity notice is dated the following Monday and the acknowledgment is signed that Wednesday. The count runs Friday and Monday: 2 business days.
- Same window; no hold; the most recent glass-supplier notice is dated the Wednesday before the window closed. It is not after the window closed, so the count runs to the signature date.
